- Stroke history: 1
- Bleeding history or predisposition: 1
- Labile INRs (International Normalized Ratios, unstable or high, time in therapeutic range <60%): 1
- Elderly (>65 years old): 1
- Drugs (NSAIDs, antiplatelet agents, anticoagulants) or alcohol usage (>8 drinks/week): 1 each
